text: Machine learning is a type of technology that allows computers to learn from data without being directly programmed. In supervised learning, a computer is given training data, which includes examples with correct answers. The computer uses this data to build a model, a kind of rule system that helps it understand patterns. Once the model is ready, it can make predictions about new information it has never seen before. The quality of these predictions is measured by accuracy, which shows how often the model is correct. Good training data usually leads to better models and more accurate predictions.
